structuredContent.summary: The change correctly implements the requirement to allow users to preconfigure advanced preferences (Privileged Filters) even when global blocking is disabled. By hardcoding mPrivilegedFilters.setEnabled(true), it decouples the interactive state of this specific control from the global toggle, while the underlying execution remains gated by the backend's global blockers snapshot and current advanced policy as per architectural rules.
test_gaps: Verify that while mPrivilegedFilters is interactive, the actual filtering logic still respects the global block state.
Ensure no side effects occur when switching global blocking back on.
recommended_changes: None required for this specific scope.
